title: T.TEST and TTEST pass rounded complement y = 1 - z to the beta CDF kernel and validate tails after sample singletons
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088, T.TEST and TTEST coerce sample arrays before validating tails and type (so singleton sample errors precede invalid tails/type, and non-numeric singletons like "" or "2" yield #DIV/0! before #NUM!), and compute the p-value by passing the rounded complement y = 1 - z (rather than direct z) to the shared incomplete beta CDF kernel (matching 109/129 retained and 195/384 independent calls when isolated from beta kernel gaps). Under compatibility version 1, @T.TEST evaluates to #NAME? while TTEST remains unprefixed.
basis: Measured across fn4_questions (ql134-ql146), prefix_metadata (rows 227, 234), and docs/research/paired-t-arithmetic-2026-11-12.md in Excel 16.0.20527.20088, and matched across 2,950/2,950 T.TEST and 2,951/2,951 TTEST full-bank rows.
